summary: Frontend-only regression of the new dedicated /products/compare page (TonAer). Verified Products mega dropdown (All Products, D/M/Q/O, real Compare Gateways link, no Product Selector / SOON placeholders), navigation to /products/compare, page heading/intro/browse-gateways link, empty state, deep linking (?product=D71, ?products=D71,M40, invalid ids, >4 clamp, uppercase), filter AND logic + NO EXACT MATCH FOUND + Remove a Filter + closest matches, full cross-series compare flow (D71/M40/Q20 -> Compare Now -> 7 categorized spec groups), Highlight Differences ON/OFF (11 diff rows on, 0 off, aria-pressed toggles), Modify Selection, VIEW PRODUCT navigation from compare page to /product?series=d&model=d71, product-page regression (embedded compare-section still works, inline onSelect keeps user on /product and updates overview, product-cta-compare href=/products/compare?product=<id> with preselection), and mobile 390px (hamburger Products accordion has Compare Gateways, no horizontal page overflow, table scrolls internally 640px in 340px container). One real UI bug found: the fixed comparison tray is not horizontally centered (framer-motion clears the Tailwind -translate-x-1/2), overflowing off-screen on mobile.

ui_bugs.issue: Tray is positioned with Tailwind 'left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2' but framer-motion's animate={{y:0}} writes/clears the inline transform (computed transform becomes 'none' after the animation), so the -translate-x-1/2 is lost. Measured desktop 1920px: tray left=960 (expected 663), right=1553; mobile 390px: left=195, right=470 -> tray extends 80px past the viewport and the 'Compare Now' button is visually clipped at the right edge (still clickable, but partly off-screen). Fix: use style/framer x: '-50%' (e.g. initial={{x:'-50%',y:30}} animate={{x:'-50%',y:0}}) or wrap the tray in a centered flex container instead of relying on the translate utility.

issues: The 'Highlight Differences' / 'Modify Selection' control row sits directly under the fixed pill nav and is partially overlapped after Compare Now auto-scroll; adding scroll-margin-top to #comparison-result would avoid the overlap (cosmetic).

action_items: Fix horizontal centering of [data-testid="compare-tray"] (framer-motion overrides -translate-x-1/2); it overflows the viewport on mobile and is off-center on desktop.
Optional: add scroll-margin-top to #comparison-result so the fixed nav does not overlap the Highlight Differences / Modify Selection row on mobile.
critical_code_review_comments: Requirement note: the request stated Wi-Fi 7 filter should match 'D71, D72, M40', but catalog data tags M40 as wifi6 (Wi-Fi 6E badge). Actual UI result is D71, D72 which is consistent with /app/frontend/src/data/catalog.js. No code bug - the stated expectation was inaccurate; confirm intent for M40's wifi tag.
CompareSection calls onSelect(p) unconditionally in the table header; it is always provided today, but a default no-op (onSelect = () => {}) would make the shared component safe for future reuse.
ComparePage remounts CompareSection via key={initial.join(',')} — acceptable, but any filter/search state is intentionally reset on URL param change; confirm this is desired.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All 10 requested scenarios were executed on https://network-journey-3.preview.emergentagent.com. Everything passed except the tray centering bug. Useful facts: catalog ids are md60,d71,d72,m20,m40,q20,q10,o10,o20; wifi7 tag only on d71/d72; an impossible AND combo for testing NO EXACT MATCH is filter-wifi7 + filter-dualband (shows 3 closest matches). Deep links clamp to max 4 and drop invalid ids; ?products=D71,M40,Q20,O10,D72 yields 4. Product page inline head click updates the URL in place (/product?series=q&model=q20) and the overview, which is correct (not a duplicate page).
rca_of_the_issue: Tray bug RCA: Tailwind class '-translate-x-1/2' compiles to a transform utility; framer-motion drives the same CSS transform property for the y animation and, on completion, resets inline transform to none/translateY(0), discarding the horizontal -50% shift. Repro: open /products/compare?products=D71,M40,Q20,O10, wait for the entrance animation to finish, then read getComputedStyle(tray).transform -> 'none' and getBoundingClientRect().left === window.innerWidth/2.
